title: Detailed croissant
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='crust' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#F5B942'/>
      <stop offset='0.55' stop-color='#E08A2B'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#B45E1C'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='body' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#FFCA63'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#E89A34'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- main crescent body -->
  <path d='M50 14
           C74 14 92 32 92 54
           C92 76 74 90 50 90
           C28 90 12 76 12 56
           C12 36 28 20 46 18
           C44 30 42 40 44 50
           C46 60 52 66 58 66
           C64 66 68 60 66 52
           C64 44 58 40 56 34
           C54 26 52 20 50 14 Z'
        fill='url(#crust)'/>

  <!-- inner lighter dough -->
  <path d='M50 24
           C70 24 84 38 84 55
           C84 73 70 84 50 84
           C32 84 20 73 20 57
           C20 42 32 30 46 28
           C44 38 44 46 46 54
           C48 62 54 64 58 60
           C62 56 60 48 57 42
           C55 36 53 30 50 24 Z'
        fill='url(#body)'/>

  <!-- top crust highlight ridge -->
  <path d='M50 20 C72 20 88 36 88 55'
        fill='none' stroke='#FFDF8A' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- segment folds -->
  <g fill='none' stroke='#A85416' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <path d='M44 34 C40 44 42 54 48 60'/>
    <path d='M60 34 C66 42 68 50 64 58'/>
  </g>

  <!-- lighter fold highlights -->
  <g fill='none' stroke='#FFD777' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <path d='M35 40 C32 48 34 56 38 62'/>
    <path d='M70 40 C74 48 72 56 68 62'/>
  </g>

  <!-- flaky shine spots -->
  <g fill='#FFE9A8' opacity='0.9'>
    <ellipse cx='58' cy='30' rx='5' ry='3' transform='rotate(-20 58 30)'/>
    <ellipse cx='30' cy='52' rx='4' ry='2.5' transform='rotate(15 30 52)'/>
    <ellipse cx='72' cy='60' rx='4' ry='2.5' transform='rotate(-15 72 60)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='5' ry='3' transform='rotate(5 50 74)'/>
  </g>

  <!-- dark bake spots on top -->
  <g fill='#8E4413'>
    <ellipse cx='47' cy='21' rx='4' ry='2.4' transform='rotate(-25 47 21)'/>
    <ellipse cx='66' cy='26' rx='3.4' ry='2' transform='rotate(20 66 26)'/>
    <ellipse cx='77' cy='40' rx='3' ry='1.8' transform='rotate(-10 77 40)'/>
    <ellipse cx='26' cy='36' rx='3' ry='1.8' transform='rotate(15 26 36)'/>
    <ellipse cx='60' cy='70' rx='3.4' ry='2' transform='rotate(-15 60 70)'/>
    <ellipse cx='38' cy='72' rx='3' ry='1.8' transform='rotate(10 38 72)'/>
    <ellipse cx='82' cy='56' rx='2.6' ry='1.6' transform='rotate(-20 82 56)'/>
  </g>
</svg>
